verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 16.13
verses.english: Linked Discourses 16.13

verses.pali: 1. Kassapavagga
verses.english: 1. Kassapa

verses.pali: Saddhammappatirūpakasutta
verses.english: The Counterfeit of the True Teaching

verses.pali: Evaṁ me sutaṁ—
verses.english: So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākassapo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Venerable Mahākassapa went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena pubbe appatarāni ceva sikkhāpadāni ahesuṁ bahutarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahiṁsu?
verses.english: “What is the cause, sir, what is the reason why there used to be fewer training rules but more enlightened mendicants?

verses.pali: Ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yenetarahi bahutarāni ceva sikkhāpadāni appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahantī”ti?
verses.english: And what is the cause, what is the reason why these days there are more training rules and fewer enlightened mendicants?”

verses.pali: “Evañcetaṁ, kassapa, hoti sattesu hāyamānesu saddhamme antaradhāyamāne, bahutarāni ceva sikkhāpadāni honti appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahanti.
verses.english: “That’s how it is, Kassapa. When sentient beings are in decline and the true teaching is disappearing there are more training rules and fewer enlightened mendicants.

verses.pali: Na tāva, kassapa, saddhammassa antaradhānaṁ hoti yāva na saddhammappatirūpakaṁ loke uppajjati.
verses.english: The true teaching doesn’t disappear as long the counterfeit of the true teaching hasn’t appeared in the world.

verses.pali: Yato ca kho, kassapa, saddhammappatirūpakaṁ loke uppajjati, atha saddhammassa antaradhānaṁ hoti.
verses.english: But when the counterfeit of the true teaching appears in the world then the true teaching disappears.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, kassapa, na tāva jātarūpassa antaradhānaṁ hoti yāva na jātarūpappatirūpakaṁ loke uppajjati.
verses.english: It’s like native gold, which doesn’t disappear as long as counterfeit gold hasn’t appeared in the world.

verses.pali: Yato ca kho, kassapa, jātarūpappatirūpakaṁ loke uppajjati, atha kho jātarūpassa antaradhānaṁ hoti.
verses.english: But when counterfeit gold appears in the world then native gold disappears.

verses.pali: Evameva kho, kassapa, na tāva saddhammassa antaradhānaṁ hoti yāva na saddhammappatirūpakaṁ loke uppajjati.
verses.english: In the same way, the true teaching doesn’t disappear as long the counterfeit of the true teaching hasn’t appeared in the world.

verses.pali: Yato ca kho, kassapa, saddhammappatirūpakaṁ loke uppajjati, atha saddhammassa antaradhānaṁ hoti.
verses.english: But when the counterfeit of the true teaching appears in the world then the true teaching disappears.

verses.pali: Na kho, kassapa, pathavīdhātu saddhammaṁ antaradhāpeti, na āpodhātu saddhammaṁ antaradhāpeti, na tejodhātu saddhammaṁ antaradhāpeti, na vāyodhātu saddhammaṁ antaradhāpeti;
verses.english: It’s not the elements of earth, water, fire, or air that make the true teaching disappear.

verses.pali: atha kho idheva te uppajjanti moghapurisā ye imaṁ saddhammaṁ antaradhāpenti.
verses.english: Rather, it’s the futile people who appear right here that make the true teaching disappear.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, kassapa, nāvā ādikeneva opilavati;
verses.english: The true teaching doesn’t disappear like a ship that sinks all at once.

verses.pali: na kho, kassapa, evaṁ saddhammassa antaradhānaṁ hoti.
Pañca khome, kassapa, okkamaniyā dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: There are five detrimental things that lead to the decline and disappearance of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Idha, kassapa, bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari agāravā viharanti appatissā, dhamme agāravā viharanti appatissā, saṅghe agāravā viharanti appatissā, sikkhāya agāravā viharanti appatissā, samādhismiṁ agāravā viharanti appatissā—
verses.english: It’s when the monks, nuns, laymen, and laywomen lack respect and reverence for the Teacher, the teaching, the Saṅgha, the training, and immersion.

verses.pali: ime kho, kassapa, pañca okkamaniyā dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These five detrimental things lead to the decline and disappearance of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Pañca khome, kassapa, dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: There are five things that lead to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.

verses.pali: Katame pañca?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Idha, kassapa, bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, dhamme sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, saṅghe sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, sikkhāya sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, samādhismiṁ sagāravā viharanti sappatissā—
verses.english: It’s when the monks, nuns, laymen, and laywomen maintain respect and reverence for the Teacher, the teaching, the Saṅgha, the training, and immersion.

verses.pali: ime kho, kassapa, pañca dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: These five things lead to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.”

verses.pali: Terasamaṁ.
Kassapavaggo paṭhamo.
Tassuddānaṁ
Santuṭṭhañca anottappī,
candūpamaṁ kulūpakaṁ;
Jiṇṇaṁ tayo ca ovādā,
jhānābhiññā upassayaṁ;
Cīvaraṁ paraṁmaraṇaṁ,
saddhammappatirūpakanti.
Kassapasaṁyuttaṁ samattaṁ.
verses.english: The Linked Discourses with Kassapa are complete.
